description: Implement interactive install/update/reinstall, remembered choices, optional-component detection, configured model provisioning, agent setup, typed full-data deletion, ordered offline migration, and manual-action reporting. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-deterministic-installer-design.md.

acceptance_criteria: Preview exact resolved Hub paths before mutation and require exact-path confirmation.
Confirm the managed runtime stops before deletion.
Remove Hub state, .venv, tool-envs, and Hub model cache while preserving installed config, agent configuration, and installer choices.
task_full_reinstall.description: Preview exact paths, stop runtime, require exact-path confirmation, remove only Hub-owned state, service/tool virtual environments, and model cache, then reinstall.
task_full_reinstall.next_action: Full reinstall now includes Hub-managed tool-envs; recovery guide and canonical install/update prompts agree. Python AST and git whitespace checks pass; deletion behavior not runtime-tested.
task_full_reinstall.title: Safe full reinstall and data cleanup

acceptance_criteria: Profile and optional-component choices persist across runs; explicit flags override them only for that run.
MCP, skills and generated instructions can be selected independently for Codex, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf and VS Code/Copilot.
Use documented per-agent global instruction and skill paths; merge only Local AI Hub owned content, back up overwritten files, and preserve unrelated settings.
Install the shared ~/.agents/skills tree only when a selected agent consumes that standard; disabled Cursor/Windsurf integrations must not receive Hub skills indirectly.
Disabling global agent setup preserves remembered per-agent choices.
Unsupported vendor interfaces or file conflicts produce an actionable manual report instead of guessing paths.
task_installer_wizard.description: Finish interactive install/update/repair choices and deterministic integration for each selected agent. Configure MCP, skills and always-on global instructions in each currently supported client format, preserving unrelated files and rendering unsupported host steps in setup-report.json.
task_installer_wizard.next_action: Static source audit confirms remembered profile/component choices, per-agent MCP/skills/instruction toggles, safe full reinstall choice, and conditional Intel OpenVINO setup. OpenVINO NPU filtering fixed. Runtime downloads and live client reload remain unverified.
task_installer_wizard.title: Interactive installer and remembered choices

acceptance_criteria: Setup report separates selected, installed, failed and not-detected components.
Missing optional CLI tools and failed dependencies link to the recovery guide.
The report warns that newly installed commands may need a new terminal to appear on PATH.
Failure reports are written for core runtime, migration, full reinstall, install payload, model provisioning, service registration, Hub restart and required agent dependencies.
Agent configuration exceptions are reported as failed or partial instead of escaping without a report.
Setup report records exact configured Ollama models as requested, ready, skipped, and unavailable.
A selected managed llama.cpp runtime or configured model that is not ready creates an actionable manual action.
Bootstrap Python/venv failures print the maintained recovery-guide path.
task_recovery_docs.description: Report installed, skipped and failed components with actionable recovery steps; include post-install detection for Token Economy dependencies, wrappers and optional CLI tools.
task_recovery_docs.next_action: Static source audit confirms distinct selected/installed/model/manual-action fields, exact Ollama model outcomes, staged failure reports, and recovery-guide links. Added PATH reload guidance. Runtime/report generation remains unverified.
task_recovery_docs.title: Installer report and manual recovery guide

acceptance_criteria: Migrations are registered as consecutive N-to-N+1 steps and applied oldest first after full-chain preflight.
Each migration uses a verified backup and staged state; a failed conversion preserves original state.
If migration application fails after payload swap, the installer transaction restores the prior code payload.
Unknown, corrupt, unversioned nonempty, or newer state is refused before code replacement.
task_state_migration.description: Inspect historical state formats; implement only verified backup-protected N-to-N+1 converters. Refuse unsupported versions without editing state.
task_state_migration.next_action: Incremental N-to-N+1 framework is ready, with full-chain preflight, verified backup, staged conversion, verification after each step, and payload rollback. Registry stays empty because no verified older state schema exists; add migrations only alongside a documented schema change.
task_state_migration.title: Ordered offline state migration framework

task_validation.description: Review changed paths, check syntax and shell/PowerShell parsing, inspect diff, and record actual unverified migration limits.
task_validation.next_action: PowerShell and bash bootstrap parsing, Python AST parsing, and git diff whitespace checks pass. No runtime install, downloads, model provisioning, or agent reload was run; acceptance for those remains unverified.
task_validation.title: Targeted installer validation and plan closeout

title: Deterministic Local AI Hub installer
